exposure: Mode of onset of labor (iatrogenic vs. spontaneous)
outcome: Rates of iatrogenic and spontaneous preterm birth
Risk factors associated with preterm birth
cohort: Singleton births between 1 April 2015 and 31 March 2017 in the English National Health Service
finding: While both iatrogenic and spontaneous preterm births were associated with certain risk factors, higher BMI was associated with increased risk of iatrogenic preterm birth and decreased risk of spontaneous preterm birth, and previous cesarean section showed similar trends.
mod_finding: Previous caesarean section was associated with an increased risk of iatrogenic preterm birth (adjRR 1.88, 95% CI 1.83-1.95) and a decreased risk of spontaneous preterm birth (adjRR 0.87, 95% CI 0.83-0.90).
